seo.title: French Immersion Homestay for Adults in Bergerac, France | French in Bergerac
seo.description: Live and learn French at your teacher’s home in Bergerac, Dordogne: a one-week French immersion for adults with 15 hours of lessons, cultural outings and half board. From €1,270.

hero.kicker: Live & learn at your teacher’s home · Dordogne
hero.title: French immersion homestay in Bergerac
hero.lead: A French language holiday for adults: practise and live French in a warm, relaxed home, immersed in the culture of the Périgord in south-west France.
hero.photoAlt: The old bridge of Bergerac and the Dordogne riverbanks at sunset

intro.title: Learn French in France by living it
intro.p1: You want to practise French intensively, combining lessons with immersion in the local culture. You like being supported, but you also value your independence.
intro.p2: Welcome to my home in the centre of Bergerac: French lessons in the morning, and in the afternoon this town of art and history on the banks of the Dordogne is yours to explore — its museums, craftspeople, cafés, terraces, restaurants and the countryside close by.

items.what: French lessons, one-to-one or in a very small group, built around your goals and interests.
Guided outings or time to explore on your own: museums, craft workshops, markets, the Dordogne riverbanks.
Three friendly evenings during the week: the best time to speak French without even thinking about it.

stay.title: One-week French immersion: the typical stay
stay.intro: A complete programme that can be adjusted to suit your preferences.
stay.priceNote: Length, pace and programme can all be adjusted: get in touch for a tailored quote.

teacher.title: My name is Clotilde
teacher.p1: I have been teaching for 13 years. I hold a CELTA and trained in teaching French as a foreign language (FLE).
teacher.p2: In one-to-one lessons or very small groups (a maximum of 4 people of the same level), we often start from a written text chosen according to your goals and interests. I focus on speaking, and I make sure to create a climate of trust so you can express yourself with confidence.
teacher.p3: My interests? Literature, cinema and theatre — we will make the most of whatever is on locally during your stay. On Sundays, the lesson can take place while walking along the Dordogne.
teacher.photoAlt: Clotilde, French teacher, on the banks of the Dordogne
teacher.yoga: Sometimes we begin a French lesson with a few simple yoga movements, some breathing exercises or a short moment of relaxation. A few minutes to release tension, refocus and help your concentration before you start speaking French. No yoga experience is needed.
teacher.yogaCredential: I trained at the Gayatri Yoga school in Tenerife, where I completed a 200-hour yoga teacher training in 2024.

house.title: Your homestay in Bergerac
house.lead: A house with a small garden, a 5-minute walk from the town centre and 5 minutes by bike from Pombonne park. The railway stations are a 10-minute walk away, perfect for exploring the region.

chambre.caption: Bedroom
chambre.alt: A guest bedroom with a double bed

jardin.caption: Garden
jardin.alt: The garden with its wrought-iron table and chairs

region.title: Bergerac, the Dordogne and the Périgord
region.p1: A town of art and history on the Dordogne river, Bergerac is best discovered on foot and by bike: the old town, the riverside, museums, cafés and restaurants.
region.p2: You can also visit the many heritage treasures of the region by car or public transport.
region.photoAlt: Colourful wall mural depicting Bergerac and its landmarks

reviews.title: They came to Bergerac to learn French

items.text: Many thanks for a week full of good things: your warm welcome, your superb cooking, your teaching. Everything prepared with precision and kindness, all the cultural and social expressions… A very rich week, full of ideas, discussions and even a little grammar — and all with humour.
items.name: Ann

items.text: The lessons were excellent and the atmosphere friendly. I highly recommend this experience to anyone who wants to improve their French.
items.name: Christina

items.question: How much does a French immersion stay in Bergerac cost?
items.answer: The typical one-week stay costs €1,270 one-to-one. It includes 15 hours of lessons, 3 guided outings, 3 evenings and half-board accommodation. A tailored quote is prepared according to your wishes.

items.question: Are lessons one-to-one or in a group?
items.answer: Both are possible: one-to-one lessons, or a very small group of no more than 4 people of the same level.

items.question: Can the length or programme be adjusted?
items.answer: Yes. The typical stay can be changed and adapted to your preferences — just get in touch.

items.question: Who is this French immersion homestay for?
items.answer: Adults who want to practise French intensively, combining lessons with immersion in the local culture, with personal support and some independence.

items.question: How do I get to Bergerac?
items.answer: The railway stations are a 10-minute walk from the house. In town everything is within walking or cycling distance, and the region can be explored by car or public transport.
